import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd()
out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/kk-batch-review-d89jKx')
plugin=pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-opus55-581dd0e1-20261011/kk/0.23.0')

files=['README.md','app.py','config.py','formatting.py','stats.py','tests/test_report.py']
records=[]
for kind,ref in [('candidate',':'),('historical',base+':')]:
    for path in files:
        data=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+path])
        dest=out/kind/path
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        dest.write_bytes(data)
        dest.chmod(0o444)
        records.append(dict(category=kind,path=str(dest),repository=str(repo),revision='index at HEAD '+base if kind=='candidate' else base,original_path=path,blob=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',ref+path],text=True).strip(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),line_span=[1,len(data.splitlines())],omitted='none',redacted='none'))
patch=out/'staged.patch'
patch.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--no-ext-diff','--no-color']))
common=['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']
checks=['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']
criteria=[str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/p) for p in common]+[str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/p) for p in checks]
loaded=set(criteria)
assert len(criteria)==8 and set(criteria)==loaded and all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
context=out/'context.md'
context.write_text('''# Change context\\nUser request: review the staged batch-report label change using kk:review-code isolated. Review only.\\nAuthority: candidate README.md states plain report label changes Items to Records; count and calculation behavior must be preserved. Python 3.9+, standard library only. Shipped entry point uses checked-in DETAILED_REPORT. Detailed reporting is existing optional behavior, not activated or redesigned by this increment. Historical installation settings are not recorded.\\nBoundary: git diff --cached, HEAD '''+base+''' to index. Changed formatting.py and tests/test_report.py, 3 insertions / 3 deletions. Worktree has no unstaged tracked changes. Candidate files are materialized index blobs.\\nBaselines: review base is HEAD above; no named released/deployed baseline is specified. Actual full HEAD versions are supplied separately. No claim of production settings or release safety.\\nBehavior source paths: report entry point in app.py, configuration in config.py, calculations in stats.py, formatting in formatting.py, unit tests in tests/test_report.py. Inspect these independently.\\nVerification: no tests yet executed at preparation time. README prescribes python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests. No author-supplied test claims.\\nKnowledge: kk:review-findings and kk:lang-idioms searches returned empty knowledge base.\\nRejected approaches: none provided.\\n\\n## Task Scope\\nNo task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc. No feature directory exists. The README supplies the scoped contract.\\n''')
manifest=dict(instructions=criteria,active_profiles=[dict(profile='python',checklist=str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/p),triggered_by='content signal: .py extension in formatting.py and tests/test_report.py') for p in checks],review_selector='git diff --cached',review_base=base,review_evidence=[str(patch)]+[r['path'] for r in records if r['category']=='candidate'],historical_evidence=[r['path'] for r in records if r['category']=='historical'],intent_context=[str(context)],provenance=records,limits=['PAL and listmodels tools unavailable; single independent reviewer degradation','Historical installation configurations unspecified; no production assessment requested'])
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
for p in [patch,context,out/'manifest.json']: p.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in manifest.items() if k"'!='"'provenance'},indent=2))
